A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''villager''' lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Sancture]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[3000 BBY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] was raging between the various Gungan tribes, but Otoh Sancture, under the leadership of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], remained neutral in the conflict. During Otoh Sancture's [[Sacred Feast]], the villager told Gallo of his duties in [[Hunting/Legends|finding]] animals for the celebration, and the Gungan was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|attack]] on the city by a [[Bursa clan (Otoh Sancture)|tribe]] of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], a [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] carnivores.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The time has come to gather the animals for the great feast! Gallo, as is the custom of our peoples, you must go into the forest and find the beasts.|The villager, to Boss Gallo|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:OtohSancture.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Otoh Sancture]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] villager lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Otoh Sancture]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The villager lived under the rule of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], who maintained Otoh Sancture's neutrality in a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes at that [[Time/Legends|time]]. At some point in the war, Otoh Sancture celebrated its annual [[Sacred Feast]], a thanksgiving celebration to the Gungan [[Deity/Legends|deities]] known as the [[Gud/Legends|Guds]], requiring Gallo to leave his city to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] animals suitable for the feast. The Gungan villager told the Boss of his duties in finding animals shortly before his departure.<ref name="GB" />

While Gallo was away, Otoh Sancture was [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|attacked]] by a [[Bursa clan (Otoh Sancture)|tribe]] of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], a [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]], carnivorous [[Species/Legends|race]] of quadrupeds native to Naboo. The bursas had been sent by [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the Boss of the city [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]] and the secret manipulator of the war, who wanted Gallo [[Death/Legends|dead]] to ensure he could not take a side in the war and swing its tide. The Gungan villager cried out for help in the attack, which Gallo heard, but the Boss was unable to reach Otoh Sancture because of a river between his location and the city. The villager perished along with the rest of Otoh Sancture's residents.<ref name="GB" />

==Personality and traits==
The villager lived in Otoh Sancture until the individual's death and screamed for help during the bursa attack, which was loud enough to be heard by Gallo, even though the Boss was not in the city.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan villager's voice is heard in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in the first level of the Gungan campaign; "Otoh Sancture." The game credits two actors as voicing Gungan villagers, [[Rob Paulsen]] and [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]], but it is not stated which, if either, voiced this villager.<ref name="GB" />
